notes.text: Raised bed 1 has tomatoes and basil, bed 2 lettuce and courgettes, bed 3 potatoes.
The garden is in shade in the afternoon because of the neighbour's walnut tree.
Frau Keller next door shares the hedge, and trimming is done together in April and September.
Watering is done in the morning only, and the tomatoes get liquid fertiliser every two weeks.
Lena is 9 and Felix is 6.
Ingrid takes the kids on Sundays.
Lena has piano on Thursdays at 16:00. Felix has football on Wednesdays and swimming on Saturdays.
The paediatrician is Dr. Aksoy and the dentist is Dr. Weiss.
Felix needs the blue blanket to sleep.
Lena is in class 3b with Herr Brandt, and Felix starts class 1 next August.
Mensa lunch is 4.50 euros and is topped up through the Schulportal.
The school office is closed on Fridays after 12:00.
Main clients are Hartmann Technik, Kowalski Verlag and the agency Lingua Nord.
Invoices go out on the last working day of the month, payment term 30 days.
Rates are 0.12 euro per word for general texts and 0.14 for legal and technical.
Hausverwaltung Roth handles repairs: email first, call only if urgent.
The weekly shop is on Saturday morning at the Markthalle, and Tom does the big one at Rewe.
The meal plan is made on Sunday evening and Friday is pizza night.
Family birthdays: Ingrid 14 Feb, Lena 23 March, Felix 9 June, Tom 3 Sept.
Kids' parties are at the climbing hall or at home, with at most 8 children.
Every summer the family goes to the Baltic coast for two weeks in July.
Christmas alternates: this year at Tom's parents in Cologne, next year at Ingrid's in Potsdam.
Maya has a BahnCard 25 and Tom drives.
Sophie from downstairs babysits for 12 euros an hour.
The car is a grey Skoda Octavia estate, TÜV every two years, winter tyres at ATU.

memories.text: They live in Pankow, Berlin.
Their children are Lena (9) and Felix (6).
Their husband is Tom, a site manager.
They are a freelance translator, working between German and English.
Their mother Ingrid lives in Potsdam.
They have a BahnCard 25.
They drink oat milk.
They go to yoga on Tuesday evenings.
They are left-handed.
They drive a grey Skoda Octavia.
Their best friend Sophie lives in the flat below.
They do their translation work in the mornings while the kids are at school.
They use Trados for translation projects.
They grew up in Dresden.
Lena and Felix go to Grundschule am Kastanienhof.
They go to the Markthalle on Saturday mornings.
They take two weeks on the Baltic coast every July.
They are learning Swedish.
They are a member of the BDÜ, the German translators' association.
They get hay fever in spring.
